items.category: JUNOS bugs found in UAC integration
items.synopsis: Connection fails are observed on Junos despite a valid auth entry
items.description: On Junos platforms, authentication failures and connection drops are observed for a few users when UAC (Unified Access Control) modules fail to look up the roles.

items.synopsis: In EVPN-VXLAN scenario DHCP does not work for clients connected on the dot1x port
items.description: On EX4300-48MP, in case of dot1x EVPN-VXLAN dynamic VLAN due to a HW setting which is used to assign VLAN to the authenticated dynamic VLAN, causes the DHCP offer to get tagged.

items.category: MX YT-ZF Linecards Interface Software Category
items.synopsis: Delay in an interface on LC9600 to come up due to repeated flaps
items.description: There is a delay in an interface on LC9600 to come up sometimes due to SerDes re-initing triggered by repeating flaps. Each plane is made of one or several Fabric ASICs (Application-Specific Integrated Circuits). The Fabric ASIC is connected to all the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) with dedicated links called SerDes. The issue caused a delay in turning up the link from 30 seconds to 80 seconds depending on if the link partner undergoes the same delay. Traffic will not pass on the port until the link is up again.

items.synopsis: Time error observed on JNP10K-LC2101
items.description: Spikes seen in 2way time error with JNP10K-LC2101 is either PTP slave or master and any switchover is done

items.synopsis: BGP scheduler slips during sub-optimal prefix-walk while deleting selected prefixes from a large set.
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, you might see the BGP scheduler slip while deleting a large set of prefixes.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is seen on telemetry streaming in BGP sharding environment
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms RPD core is seen on telemetry streaming with BGP sharding enabled.

items.synopsis: After a chassis power cycle the backup RE is in Present state and the "Loss of communication with Backup RE (Routing Engine)" alarm is seen
items.description: Occassionally on some reboots the communication link to the backup RE does not come up. In such an instance the backup RE remains in Present state (as seen in show chassis routing-engine) and the "Loss of communication with Backup RE" alarm is raised. The Re exhibiting the issue can be rebooted to clear the fault condition (request vmhost reboot)

items.synopsis: Major Host 1 Chassis Manager connection down Alarm on MX304
items.description: On rare bootups the RE-RE (RE - Routing-Engine)link reaches a wedge condition where broadcast packets are received correctly, but unicast packets are not. The afflicted RE would need to be rebooted for the RE-RE link to resume functionality

items.synopsis: On certain Junos EX and QFX platforms the static ARP entries for DHCP-security are not present
items.description: On certain Junos EX series switches, the static MAC (Media Access Control) bindings are not present in certain conditions. This issue will be seen when the static DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol)-security ARP(Address Resolution Protocol) bindings are moved from an interface having a higher interface number to an interface with a lower interface number. Due to the binding not happening, there will be impact on the traffic. The workaround when such a binding change is done is to restart the DHCP services after the configuration is committed.

items.synopsis: The PFE process crashes on ACX5448
items.description: On Junos ACX5448 platforms, the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) process will crash after continuous IFD (Interface Device) flaps. As a result, all traffic will be lost until the process recovers on its own.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss would be seen as prefix gets stuck in Hold state
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms with EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN Virtual Extensible LANs) feature, traffic loss would be observed as host prefix gets stuck in Hold state due to any network event which causes the route to delete and add in a quick succession.

items.synopsis: Commit confirm and commit race condition crashes the firewall functionality
items.description: On dual-RE (Routing Engine) Junos Evolved platforms, when the commit is executed during the commit confirm timeout window, it causes the firewalld to stop working.

items.synopsis: EAP dot1x authentication stuck in connecting state
items.description: EAP (Extensible Authentication Protocol) 802.1x authentication failure is observed on Junos QFX5K and EX4100/EX4300/EX4400 platforms in EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN) environment. Authentication gets stuck in the "Connecting" state.

items.synopsis: IGMP/MLD queries may get dropped if received on a port on the backup VC member when IGMP/MLD snooping is enabled
items.description: On Junos QFX and EX in the VC (Virtual Chassis) scenario, when the switch is acting as pure L2 (Layer 2), and forwarding IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol)/MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) query as transit traffic, if IGMP/MLD snooping is enabled then IGMP/MLD queries may get dropped if received on a port on the backup VC member resulting in IGMP/MLD groups to expire.

items.synopsis: The fxpc process crashes when the next hop information is not properly maintained in the PFE table
items.description: On Junos EX series deployed as a virtual chassis, post switchover/GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover), next hop information for Type 5 route fluctuates which leads to invalid entries in the PFE (Packet Forward Engine) table and causes the fxpc (Packet Forwarding Engine Manager) process to crash.

items.synopsis: Filter term dropping VRRP traffic when "then log" is configured
items.description: On all Junos platforms, VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) packet goes to a wrong CPU queue when filter is added to match VRRP packet with "then log" action, resulting in VRRP functionality impact.

items.synopsis: EX4400 shaping rate not working as expected
items.description: On EX platforms shaping rate on 100gig link over 70g not working as expected.

items.synopsis: The 'input-vlan-map push' operation will not work on double-tagged frames
items.description: On EX4400 platforms, when 'input-vlan-map push' is configured to push an outer VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) tag on to a double-tagged frame, the egressing frame will be tagged incorrectly. Instead of a push operation, the outer VLAN tag of the ingressing double-tagged frame will be swapped and sent out. This results in unexpected behaviour or traffic loss as the Ethernet frames will not have the expected VLAN tag information.

items.synopsis: LLDP will not work on HGoE VC mode with 40G VCP connections
items.description: On EX4400/QFX5120 platforms, having High Gigabit over Ethernet (HGoE) Virtual Chassis (VC) mode in the master, when VC members are connected by 40G links, Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) Bridge Protocol Data Unit (BPDU) from VC master destined to the remote VC members (more than one-hop away) are dropped at VCP interface due to Virtual LANs (VLANs) membership check.

items.synopsis: Port will be down when "no-auto-negotiation" is configured on EX4400-48F platform
items.description: On EX4400-48F platform with Small Form Factor Pluggable 100Base-FX Fast Ethernet Optics, when "no-auto-negotiation" is configured on the interface this results in the interface not coming back online even after deleting "no-auto-negotiation" in interface.

items.synopsis: EX4400: Flow control shows as disabled at pfe, even after enabling it
items.description: Flow control state does not show updated value in pfe cli when flow-control for a port is enabled or disabled. This is a display issue with PFE level flow control status, with no functional impact. Need to hard reboot the device or the dcpfe process restart to show correctly updated value

items.synopsis: EX4400 VC: During upgrade/reboot , fxpc core may be seen in a very rare race condition
items.description: issues aren't always seen. test cases are pre-provisioned and pfe planned restart conditions are randomly seen due to race conditions. System will auto recover after dcpfe core.

items.synopsis: EX4400: Some log messages may get flooded in heavily loaded system.
items.description: In rare scenarios in a heavily loaded system when syslog level is set to all, following log messages may get flooded - { ifinfo[72742]: PVIDB: Attribute 'ifinfo.pad_to_minimum_frame_size' not present in Db}. Recommendation is not to set syslog level to all.

items.synopsis: On certain EX platforms when 25G DAC in 4x25G is plugged into PIC port does not come up when used as VC
items.description: On EX4400, 25G (Gigabits) DAC (Direct Attach Copper) in 4x25G in PIC2 (Physical Interface Cards) when used as VC (Virtual Chassis) ports, link is not coming up and complete traffic block is observed. On EX4100, 25G DAC with 4x25G in PIC 1, link is coming up with 10G but only with partial traffic.

items.synopsis: On EX4400-48F, After phc commit in VC, default storm control config has extra xe port config for 0-11 ports and extra ge port config for 37-48 ports. This has no functionality impact
items.description: On EX4400-48F, After phc commit in VC, default storm control config has extra xe port config for 0-11 ports and extra ge port config for 37-48 ports. This has no functionality impact

items.synopsis: Runt frames generate excessive traffic statistics on EX4100/EX4400 platforms
items.description: On EX4100/EX4400 platforms with Multi-rate gigabit ethernet (MGE) ports , incorrect register is read for the runt counter and the calculation logic generates a big value. As these bytes are part of input octets, it displays incorrect value.

items.synopsis: The LLDP negotiation response is not sent back to PD when perpetual Power over Ethernet (PoE) is enabled on EX4400
items.description: On the EX4400 platform, perpetual Power over Ethernet (PoE) is enabled, and when a device is connected to more than 10 Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) Power Devices (PD) and PD restarted while perpetual PoE is enabled, the LLDP negotiation response is not sent back to PD.

items.synopsis: EX Series: Removal of notice about the availability of new POE firmware and the prompt to upgrade the same
items.description: When there is newer POE firmware version available in the Junos Software, "show poe controller" command output displays the availability details to upgrade

items.synopsis: Enhancement of PoE Controller Firmware upgrade procedure
items.description: PoE firmware upgrade gets stuck in an incompatible controller scenario leading to POE not working.

items.synopsis: Enhancement of PoE controller firmware files into Junos Software
items.description: Junos Software version package does not have sufficient PoE firmware files, leading to incompatible firmware version upgrade

items.synopsis: Memory initialization of large blocks causes traffic congestion in PFE or feature configuration fails
items.description: Memory initialization of large blocks of PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) memory such as hash table initialization expands memory which fails due to over-utilization and causes traffic congestion or feature configuration failure.

items.synopsis: The rpd process crashes when TI-LFA is enabled
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, the rpd is seen to crash when TI-LFA (Topology-Independent Loop-Free Alternate) is enabled and there are ECMP (Equal-Cost Multipath) routes present.

items.synopsis: A jdhcpd process crash is observed on all Junos platforms
items.description: On all Junos platforms with DHCP relay/server/client configured, the jdhcpd process crashes when the Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) is restarted or rebooted. The DHCP functionality could be impacted.

items.synopsis: Packet loss is observed for IPSec sessions when PMI is enabled
items.description: On SRX4k series, and vSRX platforms with PMI (Power-mode) enabled, when using IPSec tunnels, IPSec packets sent out by SRX which contain a small IP packet (less than 64 bytes) may be dropped by a non-Juniper IPSec VPN peer. Power-mode is enabled by default in Junos 21.3R1 and higher.

items.category: all logging related bugs on srx platforms
items.synopsis: Security log missing space between timestamp and hostname
items.description: JunOS upgrade to the 22.2R3, 21.3R3-S3, 22.4R1, 21.4R3-S3, 22.3R2, 22.4R2, 21.2R3-S4 , 22.1R3 the security log space between the timestamps and site-name is removed Eg. 2023-08-14T12:04:31.273-07:00device_host-name RT_FLOW - RT_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_LS [junos@2636.1.1.1.2.137 logical-system-name="JTAC-LSYS" source-address="10.10.10.10" source-port="29279" destination-address="10.10.30.20" destination-port="1603" connection-tag="0" service-name="icmp" nat-source-address="10.10.10.10" nat-source-port="29279" nat-destination-address="10.10.30.20" nat-destination-port="1603" nat-connection-tag="0" src-nat-rule-type="N/A" src-nat-rule-name="N/A" dst-nat-rule-type="N/A" dst-nat-rule-name="N/A" protocol-id="1" policy-name="ONE" source-zone-name="JTAC-Trust" destination-zone-name="JTAC-dmz" session-id="3207" username="N/A" roles="N/A" packet-incoming-interface="ge-0/0/12.0" application="UNKNOWN" nested-application="UNKNOWN" encrypted="UNKNOWN" application-category="N/A" application-sub-category="N/A" application-risk="-1" application-characteristics="N/A" src-vrf-grp="N/A" dst-vrf-grp="N/A" tunnel-inspection="Off" tunnel-inspection-policy-set="root" source-tenant="N/A" destination-service="N/A"]

items.synopsis: The tunnel went down because the IKE exchange failed
items.description: On all Junos platform Sometimes after manual failover, IKE-SA rekey does not succeed.

items.synopsis: Continuous error logs and Telemetry data might not be populated
items.description: On all Junos platforms, error logs are observed and telemetry data related to the transceiver does not get correctly populated for PICs (Physical Interface Cards). This is a non-service impacting issue.

items.synopsis: On all Junos MX Series and PTX Series routers, multiple LACP timeouts cause traffic loss due to ppman resource starvation
items.description: On all MX Series and PTX Series routers running Junos OS, during congestion, the periodic packet manager (ppman) runs short of resources and fails to send protocol data units (PDUs). This could cause LACP timeout and aggregated Ethernet interface flap, leading to traffic loss.

items.synopsis: The mcscnoopd process will be stuck in resync state after snooping configuration is deleted and added again immediately
items.description: On all Junos platforms, when the multicast snooping configuration is deleted and added again immediately, the mcscnoopd (multicast-snooping process daemon) process will be stuck in the resync state, impacting the multicast traffic.

items.synopsis: Junos prefers SRMS advertised label over IS-IS/OSPF SID label advertised via opaque-AS Extended-Prefix
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when IPv4 prefix advertisement received by an IS-IS/OSPF router in the Extended IP reachability TLV and SR mapping server (SRMS) advertisement for the same prefix received through the segment identifier (SID) label Binding TLV, then SRMS advertised label preferred over IS-IS/OSPF SID label advertised via opaque-AS Extended-Prefix. Traffic will be sent via wrong path due to this issue.

items.synopsis: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the TI-LFA and Legacy LFA are mutually exclusive, and the commit check will fail and blocks LFA on one instance
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, if configuring LFA (Loop-Free Alternate)/RLFA (Remote LFA)/PPLFA (Per-prefix LFA) in the routing-instance and TI-LFA (topology independent LFA) in the master instance, along with Segment Routing and node-link-protection with post-convergence, the commit check fails and blocks LFA on one instance.

items.synopsis: The adjacent PE Node SID label will drop from routing table when MicroLoop-Avoidance is enabled in OSPF-SR
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms when OSPF MicroLoop-Avoidance(MLA) is enabled on Segment Routing(SR) speaking node connected to LDP speaking node and this same SR node has to do SR-LDP stitching, the LDP route on the LDP facing interface will be withdrawn and eventually withdraws the node SID label if there has either LDP speaking node facing link flapping or the rpd is restarted.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop would be observed along with the error message 'Buffers are stuck on queue' when performing the OIR in the 100G QSFP interface
items.description: On QFX5110-32Q platforms, the traffic drop along with the error message "Buffers are stuck on queue" will be seen when the Online Insertion and Removal (OIR) is performed with 100G QSFPs on continuous ports 28, 29, 30, 31 at the same time.

items.synopsis: PFE crash is seen on Junos when file-logging is disabled
items.description: On Junos QFX5K platforms, when file-logging is enabled for ukern_trace handle and the logs are written continuously to the corresponding buffer due to a network issue, disabling file-logging for that handle will cause a PFE crash and will lead to a complete traffic loss.

items.synopsis: Tracking PR to add the null check for list_get_head if magic is NULL.
items.description: On all Junos platforms, as list_get_head function is called in multiple places in pfe we needed previous 3 functions on the stack which had called list_get_head, so we could debug why 'list_get_head list has bad magic' this error has occured.

items.synopsis: Packets received on a port that is in "LACP Detached" state is getting forwarded
items.description: On all Junos EX46xx/QFX5k (except QFX5100) platforms, child links that are in LACP (Link Aggregation Control Protocol) detached state are up and accepting incoming traffic, expecting it to drop.

items.synopsis: High CPU utilization causes a latency/slowness issue on QFX platforms
items.description: On QFX5110 and QFX5120 platforms, latency or slowness issue is observed when the traffic is passing through a layer 3 interface configured with just family inet/family inet6 due to unwarranted MAC lookup. This could lead to traffic loss on that interface.

items.synopsis: BFD sessions flap on EX and QFX platforms
items.description: On all EX and QFX platforms, BFD(Bidirectional Forwarding Detection) sessions are flapped with VLAN configuration change on LAG interface.

items.synopsis: The dcpfe crashes after restarting l2-learning process on QFX and EX series Junos platforms
items.description: The dcpfe process crash is observed on EX and QFX Junos platforms after restarting the l2-learning process when flex-hash is configured. It will be recovered automatically after the dcpfe restart

items.synopsis: The dcpfe process crashes on QFX5k and EX4k platforms
items.description: On QFX5k, EX4100, EX4300, EX4400, and EX4650 platforms, the dcpfe process crash will be seen when EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN) is configured.

items.synopsis: Link down due to FEC mismatch on EX4650, EX4400 and Junos based QFX5K platforms using 25G-LR optics
items.description: In a combination of EX4650 connected to EX4400 and Junos based QFX5K platforms connected to EX4400 using 25G-LR(Long Range) optics, FEC(Forward Error Correction) value mismatch between directly connected devices would cause the link to go down on Junos release version 20.4R3-S8 and above and leads to complete traffic loss.

items.synopsis: No alarm is raised when PSU is inserted with different airflow directions
items.description: On QFX5100/QFX5110/QFX5120/QFX5200 platforms, no alarm would be raised even though inserted PSU module which has a different airflow.

items.category: RPD route tables, resolver, routing instances, static routes
items.synopsis: Multipath route is not getting compute and skip the multipath eligibility check
items.description: On all Junos platforms, multipath route will not be formed correctly when a BGP route is received from RR (Route Reflector) and preference decided based on cluster list length.

items.synopsis: Complete traffic blackhole from one PFE to another on fabric links after injecting/reporting CRC errors on fabric links of MX10008
items.description: On the MX10008 platform, the low-priority stream might be marked as a destination error and as a result, the low-priority stream is stuck and all traffic might get dropped. Complete traffic blackhole is observed from one PFE to another.

items.category: Remote Access VPN issues on SRX
items.synopsis: nsd crash impacting remote access vpn on SRX devices
items.description: nsd crash can be observed on SRX platforms when the SSL certificate does not have the common name (CN), Organization Unit (OU) and Organization field, this leads to break in remote access connectivity.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: In JUNOS EVO "show | display inheritance" does not work correctly for LSPs with whitespace in the name
items.description: An LSP with whitespace in the name does not display correctly when viewing the configuration using 'show | display inheritance'

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The rpd crashes and the commit operation fails while pushing a large configuration with the "extend-size" knob enabled
items.description: On all Junos platforms, when the 'extend-size' knob is configured and a scaled configuration is committed, the rpd daemon crash is seen and the commit operation fails.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The mgd process crash is observed when 'show' is executed from the configuration mode
items.description: On all Junos platforms, when 'show' is executed from the configuration mode, a mgd process crash is observed which has no functionality impact.

items.synopsis: < ok/> response is getting generated along with < rpc-error>
items.description: When maximum-password-length is configured and the user tries to configure password whose length exceeds configured maximum-password-length, there is an error and the '' tag is emitted. (Ideally '' tag should not be emitted in an error scenario.) The configuration does not get committed.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is seen when a MAC moves from dot1x port to non-dot1x port
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms is having dot1x enabled interface. When two or more MAC addresses are learnt on a dot1x port, and if one of them is shifted to a non-dot1x port, the MAC address that was moved is still seen as a MAC-based VLAN entry on the Layer2 Address Learning Manager (l2alm). This could lead to network traffic being lost.

items.synopsis: Dcpfe core will be observed when we upgrade from 22.4I to 22.4R2.x
items.description: dcpfe core will be observed when we upgrade from 22.4I to 22.4R2.x due to PCIe address corruption during bootup time. The device can be recovered by rebooting it.

items.synopsis: QFX5130 EVO vxlan: QFX5130 always sends NS(Neighbor Solicitation) with link local address
items.description: On QFX platform series which is working on EVO and vxlan function, it sends IPv6 NS(Neighbor Solicitation) with link local address even through target IP is global address.

items.synopsis: If mixed speed members are part of a AE bundle, the AE goes down post GRES
items.description: This scenario arises when a interface of a non-existent VC member is made part of the AE bundle during pre-configuration.

items.synopsis: Intermittent MAC move is observed in VPLS environment when ACX5448 or ACX710 is acting as a PE device
items.description: On Junos ACX5448 and ACX710 platforms acting as a PE (Provider Edge) device in a VPLS (Virtual Private LAN Services) environment and multiple CE (Customer Edge) interfaces are bound to a single routing instance, intermittent MAC move is observed. This is a corner case scenario and the MAC move can be triggered due to various reasons and not limiting to mac address time out, L2 loop on the extended network or a congested backbone link connecting the PE devices. The split horizon rule in VPLS fails and the traffic received from VPLS LSI (Label-Switched Interface) is forwarded back towards the MPLS core through the LSI.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss would be seen as prefix gets stuck in Hold state
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms with EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN Virtual Extensible LANs) feature, traffic loss would be observed as host prefix gets stuck in Hold state due to any network event which causes the route to delete and add in a quick succession.

items.synopsis: The traffic drop will be observed after changing the VSTP VLAN configuration
items.description: On Junos EX4400, EX4100, EX2300, EX3400, and QFX5K platforms, traffic drop would happen on RSTP (Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol) enabled port attached to a VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) when the same VLAN has VSTP (VLAN Spanning Tree Protocol) enabled on a different port and there is a configuration change done on VSTP for that VLAN.

items.synopsis: Packet drop will be observed due to ARP resolution failure in EVPN-VXLAN scenario
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX/SRX/QFX/EX (BROADCOM based) platforms, ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) resolution is unsuccessful and packet drop will be seen, when interface mode - access is configured in EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN) ERB (Edge Routed Bridging) scenario.

items.synopsis: Alarm "PEM is not supported/powered" might be seen after removing the power cable
items.description: On EX4400 platform, system alarm 'PEM is not supported/powered' might be seen after removing a power cable from PEM.

items.synopsis: FPC temperature value will be exported incorrectly in Telemetry server
items.description: On Junos based platforms with TVP architecture, when data is streamed through telemetry the FPC temperature data is exported as 0. There is no functionality impact due to this issue.

items.synopsis: EX4400: When SFPP-10G-T optics insterted in EX4400, IFD doesnt get created
items.description: When SFPP-10G-T transceiver is inserted in PIC0 ports of EX4400-48F, IFD will not be created.

items.synopsis: EX4400 VC : Both mge and ge interfaces are getting created for all ports during master member-id and role swap with Linecard.
items.description: In case of role swap along with fpc slot change between master and linecard, the older ifds are retained on master.

items.synopsis: EX4400:PSM is not detected in "show chassis hardware" until AC feed is connected to it
items.description: PEM after insertion will not be detected/displayed in show chassis hardware, until the power feed is connected

items.category: PFE EVPN / VxLAN related issues on EX platforms
items.synopsis: Programming of native-vlan-id on the interface fails and MAC is not learned
items.description: On all EX4400 and EX4100 devices in virtual-chassis (VC) deployed, in EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network - Virtual Extensible LAN) scenario, with native-vlan-id configured on the interface, MAC (Media Access Control) address is not learned.

items.category: Express PFE Services including JTI, TOE, HostPath, Jflow
items.synopsis: PDT:Google: DCPFE core found during AE flap test on PTX1k
items.description: During heavy network churn (interface flaps, session flaps etc.) PFE crash may be seen when streaming both SR and SRTE stats on PTX JUNOS platforms. Issue is not seen when only SR stats or SRTE stats are enabled.

items.synopsis: Dhcp security bindings may not happen when DHCP security is enabled on multiple vlans along with dhcp stateless relay
items.description: When DHCP security is enabled on multiple vlans along with dhcp stateless relay enabled at that time, dhcp security bindings may not happen.

items.synopsis: The l2ald crashes when there is recursive deletion of IFBD or when BGP neighborship is cleared in EVPN-VXLAN multi-homed configuration
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, in a rare scenario, due to timing issue, the l2ald (Layer 2 Address Learning Daemon) crashes and traffic is being blackholed due to recursive deletion of IFBD (Interface Family Bridge Domain) or when BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) neighborship is cleared when EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) - VXLAN (Virtual Extensible Local Area Network) with multi-homed is configured.

items.synopsis: NTP time drift
items.description: NTP time drift on the affected Junos releases. Earlier implementation of kvmclock with vDSO (virtual Dynamic Shared Object) which helps avoid the system call overhead for user space applications had problem of time drift, the latest set of changes takes care of initializing the clock after all auxiliary processors are launched so that the clock initialization is accurate.

items.synopsis: EX4100/EX4400 device is not able to recover from OAM
items.description: OAM snapshot recovery not working as expected, post "request system reboot oam" system should boot OAM recovery mode, but system is rebooting back with current installed image.

items.synopsis: EX4400 OAM snapshot recovery not working as expected
items.description: OAM snapshot recovery not working as expected, post "request system reboot oam" system should boot OAM recovery mode, but system is rebooting back with current installed image.

items.synopsis: Control plane flap, data drop, unexpected behavior of PFE or device is observed when file storage is impacted in a continuous ksyncd process crash scenario
items.description: On all Junos platforms configured with GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover), file storage in the system will get affected when the ksyncd process crashes continuously and result in control plane flap, data drop or unexpected behavior of PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) or device.

items.synopsis: FPCs crash after performing upgrade to 22.3R2.6 for ptx5k: nh_get_type_handle
items.description: when the upgrade happens to new release and config is applied, RPD might create parallel MBBs due to this number of nexthops might increase and on-chip memory exhaustion might happen at FPC. This can lead to FPC crash. Issue should not be seen once system settles down.

items.synopsis: The dcpfe process crash will be seen on the system
items.description: On Junos specific devices QFX5110/QFX5120/EX4650/EX4400/EX4100, dcpfe crash will be seen during the creation of the network port for VPLAG (virtual port lag).

items.synopsis: QFX5120 reboots due to deletion of EP style interface with native vlan configured
items.description: QFX5120 will reboot without causing a dcpfe crash upon the deletion of EP style (Enterprise Style), and trunk interfaces with multiple IFLs and native VLAN configured.

items.synopsis: Sometimes 100G link will go down and will remain down
items.description: On the Junos QFX5200 platform, sometimes 100G link will go down and will remain down

items.synopsis: Traffic is not load-balanced when one of the next-hop LSP is down
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, in the multi-LSP next-hop load-balance scenario, in case any one of the label-switched path (LSP) is down, the traffic will not be load-balanced to the rest of the LSPs, due to the weight of LSP next hops not being set correctly.

items.synopsis: Traffic drops with percent policer attached using list
items.description: On Junos EX92xx, MX304 and MX series platforms with MPC10, MPC11 and LC9600, traffic drop will happen with the attachment of family filter configured with percent policer (bandwidth-percent) via input-list/output-list.

items.category: Issues related to broadband edge apps (PPP, DHCP) on Trio ch
items.synopsis: PADT response will not be sent for an incoming PPPoE/PPP data Packet from an unknown session ID
items.description: On all MX platforms with line cards before MPC10, when Broadband Network Gateway (BNG) switchover occurs, the new master does not send PPPoE Active Discovery Termination (PADT) packet for an unknown session if the incoming packet is PPPoE/PPP data packet and thus the existing subscribers does not come up on this router.

items.synopsis: Memory leak is observed on all Junos SRX platforms with http-persist and http-reassembly configuration
items.description: On all Junos SRX platforms with http-persist and http-reassembly configuration when firewall policy is attached with enhanced or redirect WF (Web Filtering) policy, memory leak will be observed in PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) which leads to traffic drop.
